# CR-001 — Env-gate production demo mode (FEAT-031) / ปลด demo mode ที่ hardcode ใน production

**Status:** approved (Boss, 2026-08-09 — direct order in planning session) · **Mode:** DDD
**Plan ref:** SmartGift `docs/implementation-plan-2026-08-09.md` §5 (ZUMP01 Phase 1) · **Risk ref:** Risk Register #1

## Problem / ปัญหา

Production has served deterministic demo fixtures to every tenant since the 2026-07-24
presentation hotfix chain (`5f1c5e5` → `aad4d65`):
production เสิร์ฟข้อมูล demo ให้ทุก tenant ตั้งแต่ hotfix งานพรีเซนต์ 2026-07-24:

1. `src/lib/demoData.js` — `isClientDemoMode()` is hardcoded `return true` (no env flag).
2. `src/lib/mockMode.js` — `isMockMode` includes `VERCEL_ENV === 'production'`, forcing every
   production deployment into mock mode by definition.
3. `src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/auth-config.js` — a presentation credential
   (`admin@vschool.io` / `admin`) is accepted **before** the login rate limiter runs:
   a hardcoded, brute-forceable-without-limit backdoor in production.
4. `src/lib/repositories/employeeRepo.js` — duplicate literal of the seeded email.

## Change / การแก้

| # | File | Change |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `src/lib/demoData.js` | `isClientDemoMode()` returns `process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ZURI_DEMO_MODE === 'true'` — demo is opt-in per deployment, default OFF everywhere. |
| 2 | `src/lib/mockMode.js` | Remove the `VERCEL_ENV === 'production'` clause. Mock mode remains available via explicit flags (`ZURI_DEMO_MODE`, `MOCK_MODE`, …) or missing `DATABASE_URL` (local dev convenience). |
| 3 | `auth-config.js` | Delete the pre-rate-limit presentation block. Demo login moves **after** the rate limiter, requires `isMockMode` **and** `ZURI_DEMO_PASSWORD` set in the environment — no working credential ships in the repo. |
| 4 | `employeeRepo.js` | Drop the duplicate `'admin@vschool.io'` literal (use `MOCK_ADMIN.email`). |
| 5 | `.env.example` | Document `ZURI_DEMO_MODE`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_ZURI_DEMO_MODE`, `ZURI_DEMO_PASSWORD` with a "never set in production" warning. |
| 6 | `src/lib/demoMode.test.js` (new) | Regression tests below. |
| 7 | `src/app/(auth)/login/page.jsx` | Derive client demo visibility solely from `NEXT_PUBLIC_ZURI_DEMO_MODE`; remove the shipped one-click demo credential and retain normal login only. |
| 8 | `src/components/layouts/Topbar.jsx`, `src/components/layouts/MobileTopbar.jsx` | Derive the Demo badge solely from `NEXT_PUBLIC_ZURI_DEMO_MODE`; production-like builds must render no demo indicator. |
| 9 | `src/app/(auth)/login/page.jsx` | Remove the client-side `NEXT_PUBLIC_BYPASS_LOGIN` credential injection; a public browser variable must never carry a working account or password. |

## Acceptance Criteria / เกณฑ์ยอมรับ

- **AC1:** Given a production-like env (`VERCEL_ENV=production`, `DATABASE_URL` set, no demo
  flags), When `isClientDemoMode()` / `isMockMode` are evaluated, Then both are `false`.
- **AC2:** Given `NEXT_PUBLIC_ZURI_DEMO_MODE=true` (resp. `ZURI_DEMO_MODE=true`), Then demo/mock
  mode is on — sales-demo deployments stay possible, per deployment, opt-in.
- **AC3:** Given production-like env, When logging in with `admin@vschool.io` / `admin`,
  Then login fails (no mock path, normal DB + bcrypt + rate limit path only).
- **AC4:** `git grep` shows no working credential pair in the repo (email fixture remains as
  mock data; its password now exists only in the deployer's environment).
- **AC5:** Existing test suite stays green (`npx vitest run`).
- **AC6:** A production-like client build has no hardcoded `isDemoMode = true`, no shipped
  `admin@vschool.io` / `admin` sign-in action, and no Demo badge on either desktop or mobile
  top bar. A deliberate demo build can still expose an explicit visual indicator, but never a
  browser-shipped demo password.

## Out of scope / นอกขอบเขต

Per-tenant demo flag UI (future sales-demo feature — plan §1.4), rate-limit fail-open fix
(CR-002, next), removal of demo fixture data files (they are inert once gated).

## Rollout / การปล่อย

Merge → verify Vercel project has **none** of the three flags set → deploy → smoke: login page
rejects demo credential; a real tenant login works; dashboards show tenant data (or empty state),
not the fixture numbers. Rollback = revert commit (flags are additive, no schema change).
